lines.text: It’s project time! Build an app that asks an anonymous number question, collects the answers in a list, and reports the number of responses, average, maximum and minimum, plus one extra insight.
Choose a number question to ask classmates: hours of sleep, minutes of reading, number of pets.
Ask how many people will answer, then repeat that many times: ask the question and add the answer to the list.
Report the number of responses, the average, the highest and the lowest.
Add one more insight of your own.
Collect only what you need, keep it anonymous, and tell people what it’s for.
Never collect names with sensitive answers.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
